digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, LLM model resolution runner
propositions: code-review.yaml declares model class on all five LLM-calling steps, but every declaration is silently ignored at runtime; every call runs on cfg.model regardless of step's declared class
PydanticAIRunner discards req.config.model and resolves from self._config, causing per-step model values computed upstream to be thrown away before resolution
Step 0 adds observability: REBAR_USAGE_LOG records carry step ID and declared model_class via ContextVar, enabling per-step attribution in usage records
the plumbing from gate dispatch through RunnerAgentStep correctly resolves per-step models into req.config, but that resolved value never reaches _pai_model invocation
live probe with discriminating class table (values differing from cfg.model) proves all five code-review steps ran on cfg.model despite declaring frontier/standard classes
